title: Computation of the Processing Fee on an Entrance Fee Agreement Cancelled Before Occupancy
content:
**Clause.** On a cancellation of an **Entrance Fee Agreement** before occupancy signed by the resident after the rescission period, the processing fee is the plan's pre-occupancy cancellation processing fee percentage of the entrance fee of the agreement, rounded to the cent half up, and it is retained from the money paid as one processing fee entry dated the day the cancellation is signed. The amount so obtained is the processing fee entered on the agreement's ledger, and the refundable balance falls by it.

## Inputs and where they are read

| Input | Source |
|---|---|
| Entrance fee of the agreement | The agreement record (total entrance fee, any second person fee included) |
| Processing fee percentage | The plan's pre-occupancy cancellation processing fee percentage in the refund plan schedule |
| Date of the entry | The day the cancellation is signed |

The percentage acts on the entrance fee of the agreement, not on the money actually received so far; the product is rounded once, to the cent, half up.

## Worked figures (hypothetical agreement)

| Line | Amount |
|---|---|
| Entrance fee of the agreement | 340900.00 |
| Plan percentage (2 percent, for this illustration) | 2 |
| Processing fee: 340900.00 multiplied by 2 percent | 6818.00 |
| Deposit received before the cancellation | 34090.00 |
| Refundable balance after the processing fee entry | 27272.00 |

A second illustration: an entrance fee of 377650.00 at the same 2 percent gives 7553.00.

## Points of reading

- One cancellation carries one processing fee entry.
- The entry lowers the refundable balance by exactly the amount retained.
